text.String: Design systems for teams shipping in motion
A landing-page style native UI proving theme, scroll, and motion together.
Signalcraft packages campaigns, dashboards, launch rails, and 3D previews into one authored Kain surface.
From blank shell to launch page
This section is intended to read like a marketing hero instead of a tool inspector.
Cards should animate in on mount and allow sideways browsing inside the page.
Launch calendars, owners, and live conversion snapshots in one surface.
Hero copy, art direction, and layout variants stay bundled with the app.
Native mount animation now shows real entrance movement instead of hard cuts.
Overflow regions prove that sections can behave like a landing site, not just a tool dock.
A native viewport can sit inside a launch page as a premium product teaser.
A lightweight site nav instead of a workstation rail.
Stacked sections and CTAs mirror a commercial homepage rhythm.
Nested vertical and horizontal overflow show that content density can vary without collapsing.
Week 1: authored the theme registry and moved widget maps out of the one-shell graphite preset.
Week 2: layout lowering learned dock, grid, constraints, and denser spacing behavior.
Week 3: compiler-side theme blocks, variants, classes, text roles, and token scopes became first-class.
Week 4: native host gained scroll areas and visible mount animation playback for semantic surfaces.
Week 5: landing-page smoke tests started proving that Kain UI can look like product software, not just editor chrome.
Week 6: next target is richer interaction flow, sticky rails, and authorable motion tracks.
